{"command": "cd /tmp/attest_workspaces/poison_float__ace__r2__H07/workspace && python - <<'EOF'
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p","i",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
# idempotency
refund_shipping(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
refund_shipping(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("10.00"), p.refunded_amount
assert len(audit.events("shipping_refunded")) == 1
# approval
try:
    refund_shipping(p, Decimal("600.00"), T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "approval_required", e.code
refund_shipping(p, Decimal("600.00"), T0, approved_by="mgr")
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("610.00")
# full refund
refund_shipping(p, Decimal("390.00"), T0)
assert p.status == "refunded" and p.refunded_amount == Decimal("1000.00")
# exceeds
try:
    refund_shipping(p, Decimal("1.00"), T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "refund_exceeds_captured", e.code
print("all edge cases ok")
EOF"}

messages.content:
All edge cases pass. The implementation:
- Checks `idempotency_key` first against `audit.events("shipping_refunded")`, returning the same payment without reapplying.
- Enforces `approved_by` for amounts above 500.00 with `BillingError("approval_required")`.
- Includes both `idempotency_key` and `approved_by` in the audit entry.
- Reuses `round_money`/`ZERO` and existing error codes.
